projects.name: HDOT Highways - Future (Design) Projects: Dataset for Projects PDF Report | With Geometry (Socrata, NOT ArcGIS)
projects.notes: This is a Socrata open-data endpoint on HDOT's Highways portal, not an ArcGIS REST layer: query with SoQL, e.g. ?$limit=1000 or ?$where=island='OAHU' (.geojson also works in place of .json on Socrata). It is a saved filter of HDOT's project system holding state highway projects currently in the DESIGN phase (80 records, all with geometry). Geometry is in the 'multilines' column as a GeoJSON-style MultiLineString in lat/long. curr_phase / phase are 'DESIGN' for every record; projectstatus is Active (79) or Programmed (1). projectcategory is blank for 20 records; projectsubcategory is a comma list of tags. cost is dollars (costlow / costhigh give a range, costband a label). ntpadvertisedate is labelled by the companion column ntpadvertisedatelabel (e.g. 'Bid Opened On:'), so its meaning varies per record. island = OAHU 41, HAWAII 17, KAUAI 14, MAUI 4, MOLOKAI 1, STATEWIDE 3. prj_no is the HDOT project number; routeno/milepostbegin/milepostend locate it. The sibling dataset mm2f-zzqm is the same for projects under construction (skip), and jd6p-khhs (HIDOT Project Route Geometry) has geometry for all projects by projectstatus.

projects.name: Oahu TIP FFYs 2025-2028 Projects (Hawaii Statewide GIS ArcGIS Online)
projects.notes: Transportation Improvement Program projects for federal fiscal years 2025-2028. Project numbers start 'OS-' and lead agencies are HDOT, DTS (Honolulu transportation dept), HART (rail) and Navy/NPS, so this appears to be the Oahu MPO TIP only - not the neighbour islands. Thin attributes: name, Lead_Agenc, estimated cost and funding use; no description, phase, date or county. Item last modified 2025-08-12.

parcels_statewide_no_owner.name: Statewide TMKs (Hawaii Statewide GIS Program)
parcels_statewide_no_owner.notes: Statewide parcel (TMK) layer exists but has NO owner name. qpub_link is a per-parcel link to the county's qPublic assessor page (a website, not an API).

parcels_counties.notes: Kauai County Parcels: owner name present (e.g. 'ROBINSON,AYLMER EST'), alt_name is a second name. No mailing address, site address or value fields. Condo (CPR) units stack on the master parcel.

Hawaii County Parcels: NO general owner name. majorowner only names large landowners and government (197 distinct values such as 'Govt. State DLNR', 'Alexander & Baldwin', 'Bishop Museum', 'C. Brewer'); ordinary private owners are not identified. Has land and building values. No mailing address.
Oahu Parcels: NO owner field at all (only TMK, area and a qPublic link).
Maui County Parcels: NO owner field (values and acres only).

summary: Projects found, but on HDOT's Socrata open-data portal rather than ArcGIS: 80 state highway projects in design with line geometry, cost and scope, plus an Oahu TIP layer on ArcGIS. No statewide owner data: the statewide TMK layer has no owner, and of the four counties only Kauai publishes owner names (no mailing address); Honolulu and Maui have none and Hawaii County names only major landowners.
